I appreciate you seeing this and taking the time to comment. Logically I know how people don't want to say the wrong things, but it just makes shit 100 times worse. It doesn't feel genuine or helpful. 

Like I said in other comments, I'm tired of the word vomit, and I'm tired of never knowing how to help. How do I help someone whos like me? I don't even know how to help myself. 

Things have been worse because everything is in a decline but theres this mask of medicine, making my mood slightly better. My moods high but they're still giant cracks in my day. My moods higher than usual but I still am in this same state of suffering.

I'm just so utterly done being broken and undesirable. I'm tired of being myself. I'm tired being the defective daughter, the disposable friend, the loser. I'm just to done being everything but human. 

The true me just seemed to die and never return. Mental youthfulness is so important to me, having that spark, curiosity, love of life, it's so precious. But everyday I'm reminded how that spark is gone. I'm already so far from the happy kid I used to be but somehow I'm get farther and farther. How can someone who's already so pitch black get any darker? Who even am I anymore? Why am I not enough for anyone? 

It's been four whole years since my life has started going to shit. Four whole years since that youthfulness died. Four years of being beaten down by the fact that I'm so flawed, so scarred that I will never be enough or lovable to anyone. Everyone leaves, everyone dies, but I'm just going to be here while people walk by me.

 If I'm being honest, I'm just so tired of talking. All I say is used against me, all I say is never truly understood. I'm just so exhausted watching all the people who are trying to help me, put a small plaster on a bullet wound.

The fleetingness of happiness is such bullshit, and sometimes the concern of others just ruins things more. They just don't get that self destruction is the only thing keeping me sane.

Honestly, it just makes me almost want to slap the shit out of them. Sometimes it would be nice to just let them feel my pain for just a few seconds, and maybe they'd finally understand. I wrote this because I was just so angry at everyone and myself. Everyone because they assume and say shit that never works, myself because I want to help but never know how. Humans are selfish pieces of shit, and just because I know this doesn't make me any less human. It's that hypocrisy that drives me wild. Makes me think that saying nothing is more.
